newsitem.title: UK: Barclays shares climb with buyback hopes.
newsitem.headline: Barclays shares climb with buyback hopes.

text.p: Shares in Barclays continued to rally on Tuesday after the possibility of another share buyback was highlighted by analysts at Panmure Gordon on Monday.

The shares were up 16p to 10.22-1/2 stg by 1320 GMT, after adding 12p yesterday. Over 2 million shares had changed hands. "The shares have been a little left behind recently," said one market-maker. "NatWest has had a good run and Barclays is playing catch-up," he added.
David Poutney at Panmure Gordon moved the stock to a "buy" yesterday and advised clients to buy up to 11.00 stg, commenting that there was a good chance Barclays would buyback more shares.
